quest.title: Behind His Back
quest.description: At Thoma's invitation, you come to the Yashiro Commission, only to hear two samurai talking about him behind his back...

talks.objective: Go to the place you and Thoma agreed on

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I agree. Let them do them, and you do you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I can't say I agree.
